claim: *The upload-entitlement domain.* A user belongs to one or more groups; a group carries either a finite credit balance or unlimited use. The admission decision needs both facts, so a representation that can express only the finite balance cannot answer the question the decision asks.

topology.description: User-group multiplicity; finite/unlimited entitlement alternatives must both feed admission.

bw_encoding: All finite/unlimited peers, decision and outputs white; named entitlement modes and admission branches encode consequences.
redesign: All finite/unlimited peers, decision and outputs white; named entitlement modes and admission branches encode consequences. Orthogonal group fork, separate decision input ports and shared output rail.
alt: A user belongs to one or more groups. The group branches into finite credits and unlimited entitlement. Both alternatives feed an upload decision ending in admit or reject; the decision must preserve both facts.

review.reference: current authored SVG (not older D2 receipts)
review.outcome: Common entitlement gray groups finite/unlimited alternatives and decision, preserving both inputs and admit/reject outcomes.
review.strict_compile: zero warnings, overfull boxes, missing glyphs or errors

style_review.fill: All finite/unlimited peers, decision and outputs white; named entitlement modes and admission branches encode consequences.
style_review.bold: No bold body or node labels; semantic hierarchy uses placement, spacing and named structure.
style_review.routing: Orthogonal group fork, separate decision input ports and shared output rail.
style_review.shape: Ordinary boxes use modest rounded corners; semantic document, state, decision, marker and quantitative shapes retain their roles.
style_review.visual_review: Original source and candidate semantics compared; final-size native render inspected for fill, hierarchy, routes and legibility.
